An '''unidentified R5-series astromech droid''' was owned by the [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] [[Brayl]]. The [[R5-series astromech droid|droid]] was known to get grumpy if it didn't get a regular [[Oil/Legends|oil]] bath.
